description: Find services using deterministic keywords, bounded language aliases and category/protocol/pricing filters. Prefer requestJson (at most 8192 UTF-16 code units): serialize the complete request as JSON in this single string to preserve every field through connectors. query and queryEnglish each allow at most 200 UTF-16 code units after trimming; never truncate or drop constraints to fit. Do not combine requestJson with top-level fields. Unknown inner fields are rejected. Legacy top-level calls remain available, but connectors may discard unknown fields before ToolSkipper sees them. Compare search.originalQuery, effectiveQuery and appliedFilters with your intended conditions; inspect search.reasonCodes, warnings and suggestions, including when no matches are returned. For a conditional request, preserve the complete wording in originalRequest, use focused service words in query, and keep requirements plus executionPolicy separately. All policy fields must be false; discovery never executes. This caller-supplied decomposition and requirements remain unassessed. Inspect search.discovery; metadata candidates do not establish full task suitability. Use recommend_services for structured account/protocol/payment filtering; a prohibition on paying now does not exclude paid services from discovery. queryEnglish requires the original nonempty query. In separated discovery translate the focused query faithfully while keeping every original condition in originalRequest, requirements and structured filters; otherwise translation must retain every query constraint. Defaults to five compact results with metadata match reasons, not quality scores. Use get_connection_spec for sourced setup options and get_task_options for the separate keyless task pilot. This search makes no external translation, provider execution or payment calls.

category.description: Filter by an exact catalogue category identifier.

executionPolicy.description: Requires originalRequest. All three fields must be false: providerCalls, accountConnections, payments. This restricts current actions, not which paid or account-based services may be discovered. Use recommend_services constraints.payment:no_payment to filter out paid options.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return; defaults to 5.

offset.description: Skip this many matched results; defaults to 0. Page with limit and offset while preserving the same query and filters.

originalRequest.description: For separated discovery, preserve the COMPLETE request exactly, including prohibitions and service conditions, in 1–2000 Unicode characters. Query holds service-search terms. Decomposition is not verified by ToolSkipper.

pricing.description: Filter by recorded pricing model; this does not authorize payment or establish task cost.

protocol.description: Filter by a declared service interface; a match is not proof of task execution support.

query.description: Service-search terms, at most 200 UTF-16 code units after trimming. With separated discovery, preserve the complete user request in originalRequest and keep service requirements explicit. Never silently drop constraints. Required and nonempty with queryEnglish or originalRequest.

queryEnglish.description: Optional English wording for query, 1–200 UTF-16 code units after trimming. Requires original nonempty query. With originalRequest, translate the focused query faithfully and preserve every original condition in full context and filters; otherwise retain all query constraints. Translation is caller-supplied and unverified.

requestJson.description: Preferred: serialize the COMPLETE search request into this one JSON string (at most 8192 UTF-16 code units); never mix with top-level arguments. Fields: query, queryEnglish, category, protocol, pricing, limit, offset, view, originalRequest, requirements, executionPolicy. query/queryEnglish each max200 after trimming. For 'find a service, but do not pay/connect/run', preserve the complete wording in originalRequest, use focused service terms in query, retain service conditions in requirements/filters, and use executionPolicy with providerCalls:false,accountConnections:false,payments:false. Requirements/decomposition stay unassessed. Do not equate payment prohibition now with free-service-only preference. No unknown/duplicate keys or truncation.

requirements.description: Up to eight preserved service requirements, each 1–200 Unicode characters. Requires originalRequest; requirements remain unassessed and cannot be claimed satisfied.

view.description: Compact results include source dates and exact metadata match reasons. Use full for all catalogue fields.

name: search_services

reasonCodes.description: Empty when matches exist. Otherwise identifies the first blocking cause: an overlong query, no searchable terms, unsupported exclusions/alternatives/numerical comparisons, or no match in the current published catalogue. It does not establish that no suitable provider exists elsewhere. REST/MCP reject overlong requests before returning search results.
